One continuous 10-second vertical smartphone selfie talking-head video of this same owner-authorized adult man. The IMAGE is the exact new wardrobe and appearance reference: muted olive casual cotton overshirt worn open over a plain off-white crew-neck T-shirt, transparent glasses, same facial identity, skin texture, hair and stubble. Preserve that outfit throughout.

The VIDEO is the owner-selected HOME selfie setup. Preserve its physical room, soft window light, lens perspective, close framing, relative placement of the window and shelves, supporting arm and slight handheld camera character. The reference VIDEO's old navy shirt and old mouth timing are superseded. Start in the close home composition shown by the IMAGE, not a new wide shot, no redesign of the room. Camera is his own front-facing phone held at arm's length slightly above eye level; the phone itself stays outside frame. Preserve unpolished everyday phone-camera texture and honest skin texture. No beauty smoothing, studio lighting, cinematic bokeh, face reshaping or enhanced glamour.

The AUDIO is a new 9.985-second performance in this man's selected voice. Follow its current syllables, pauses, pitch changes and conversational breath naturally. The new delivery is off the cuff: talking to one familiar person as the thought unfolds, with softer projection, naturally varied inflection and pace, light connected words. Let small facial adjustments accompany changes in thought without copying every vocal rise into a nod or eyebrow lift. Keep the comfortable near-lens engagement and restrained head/shoulder behavior of the owner-selected VIDEO. Natural blinking, subtle asymmetry and occasional brief settling are welcome. No presenter smile, repeated nodding, exaggerated emotion, dramatic leaning or theatrical gestures. His phone-holding arm remains stable; free hand may move modestly but does not dominate the close frame.

Speak ONLY the exact new AUDIO from its beginning, preserving its voice, words, pace and pauses: "A buyer is sitting across the table from a woman who has run the same business for twenty five years. It makes money." The audio, not the old video, controls speech timing. Finish the final word fully and settle naturally into the existing final silence. No added words, filler, laughter, music, ambience, sound effects, subtitles, titles, logos or cutaways. Real-time continuous performance, no camera cuts or zoom.
